sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellowish brown, slightly darker anteriorly; antennae uniformly yellowish brown; mandibles dark reddish brown, slightly paler at the base; labrum pale reddish brown; legs and abdomen white. Pilosity of the head very sparse, denser on the margins of the pronotum and on the body. Head suboblong-oval, sides slightly convex, very weakly narrowed anteriorly; head capsule 1.99–2.09 mm long to base of mandibles, 1.55–1.65 mm wide; width of mandible base 1.07–1.12 mm; ratio of maximum width to head length 0.775; ratio of mandible-base width to maximum width 0.679. Antennae 16–17-segmented; segment 4 shortest. Labrum triangular, apex narrowly rounded; each side with a row of long setae and several short hairs. Mandibles long and slender, tips weakly incurved; left mandible 1.15–1.22 mm long; ratio of mandible length to head length 0.565. Left mandible with a small lateral tooth slightly below the middle; tooth 0.64–0.65 mm from the tip; ratio of tooth distance to mandible length 0.542. Right mandible with a minute vestigial tooth near the base. Postmentum subrectangular, sides nearly parallel, slightly wider below the middle; 1.20–1.38 mm long, 0.64–0.65 mm maximum width. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin weakly notched, posterior margin distinctly emarginate; 0.64–0.65 mm long, 1.12–1.16 mm wide.
